meta.subject: fixed redundnat cache fill with dirty block, fixed cache tag_store critical path

en.summary: Fixes cache tag and dirty-state handling for fill-versus-write operations, especially when a redundant fill encounters a dirty resident line.
why_it_counts: The patch changes core cache tag-access, tag-store, and writeback-control RTL.
The commit message explicitly describes a redundant-fill bug involving dirty blocks.
The behavioral portion is concrete enough to isolate even though the same commit also reduces tag-store critical-path pressure.
disqualifiers: Part of the commit is also a timing-oriented tag-store cleanup.
A follow-up commit the next day further refines redundant-fill handling, so this entry should be read as the fill-versus-write tag-state fix, not the final word on redundant fills.
evidence: VX_tag_store.v replaces the shared write_enable and write_fill interface with separate do_fill, do_write, and invalidate controls; only fills now write the tag RAM and clear dirty, while normal writes only set dirty.
VX_tag_access.v changes fill handling from a !tags_match-only fill_write path to an explicit use_do_fill path and computes writeen_out as use_do_write || use_do_fill.
In this commit, dirty_out is masked when is_fill_in && tags_match, which suppresses writeback on a redundant fill hitting an already matching line.
VX_bank.v keeps fill and writeback traffic distinct with separate dwbq_is_fill and dwbq_is_wb decisions.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix separates two cache-line state transitions that were previously conflated: installing a line from a fill, and marking an already resident line dirty because of a write hit. When those actions share one generic write-enable path, a fill that collides with an already-present dirty line can clear or preserve the wrong metadata, suppress a needed writeback, or rewrite tag state as if the event were a normal hit.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache line tag and dirty-state update on fill-hit collisions
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A fill arrives for a line whose tag already matches a resident entry, especially when that line is dirty or when redundant fills are still possible in the pipeline.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Merge fill installation and write-hit dirty marking back into one control path, and let redundant fills use the wrong dirty or writeback semantics.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: merge fill and write metadata paths
portability_notes: Map this to any cache tag array or metadata RAM that tracks valid, dirty, and tag fields.
The key mistake is treating fill and write-hit updates as interchangeable even though one installs a line and the other only dirties an existing line.
If the target DUT can observe redundant fills, the injected bug should also suppress or distort the writeback decision for that case.
concrete_injection_steps: Replace separate fill and write metadata controls with one generic write-enable path that updates tag and dirty state together.
Allow normal write-hit metadata rules to apply during a fill, or allow fill rules to apply during a write hit, instead of keeping those transitions distinct.
When a fill hits an already matching line, suppress dirty reporting or writeback based only on the tag match rather than on the full replacement policy and line state.
Keep the bank-side writeback request logic dependent on that conflated metadata so the wrong tag and dirty semantics propagate into external traffic.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Tag access and tag store control for fill, write, invalidate, and dirty-driven writeback
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit splits tag-store fill and write behavior, makes fills use an explicit do_fill path, and keeps bank-side fill versus writeback control separate for redundant-fill handling.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_tag_store and VX_tag_access, collapse do_fill and do_write back into a shared write_enable-style path, and in VX_bank restore the earlier fill-versus-writeback coupling that depended on that shared metadata behavior.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A redundant or colliding fill can clear or preserve the wrong dirty state, skip a required writeback, or rewrite tag metadata incorrectly, leading to lost modified data or incorrect cache-line state.
evidence_for_injection: The commit introduces explicit do_fill and do_write controls in VX_tag_store, showing that the previous shared control was semantically wrong for at least some cases.
The commit message names a dirty-block redundant-fill bug, not just a critical-path cleanup.
VX_bank.v distinguishes fill requests from writebacks in the same patch, which ties the metadata fix to externally visible cache behavior.
notes: This entry should be interpreted as a fill-versus-write tag-state fix.
Later commit ce95c40aee45e7bc61a76eada543ac24256f2c36 further fixes when redundant fills are generated, but that does not erase the metadata-semantics bug fixed here.

zh.summary: 该修复把 cache 中 fill 与 write 两类元数据更新语义分离，重点处理冗余 fill 命中脏行时的 tag 和 dirty 状态错误。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心 cache 的 tag access、tag store 和 writeback 控制 RTL。
提交信息明确指出是 dirty block 上的 redundant fill bug。
虽然同一提交也在降低 tag_store 关键路径压力，但行为修复部分仍然足够具体，可以独立提取。
disqualifiers: 该提交的一部分也属于面向时序的 tag_store 清理。
第二天的后续提交继续细化 redundant fill 处理，因此这里应理解为 fill 与 write 的 tag-state 修复，而不是 redundant fill 问题的最终版本。
evidence: VX_tag_store.v 把共享的 write_enable 和 write_fill 接口拆成独立的 do_fill、do_write 和 invalidate；fill 现在才写 tag RAM 并清除 dirty，而普通写只设置 dirty。
VX_tag_access.v 把 fill 处理从仅在 !tags_match 下触发的 fill_write 路径，改成显式的 use_do_fill 路径，并把 writeen_out 定义为 use_do_write || use_do_fill。
在这个提交中，dirty_out 会在 is_fill_in && tags_match 时被屏蔽，从而在冗余 fill 命中已有匹配行时抑制 writeback。
VX_bank.v 用独立的 dwbq_is_fill 和 dwbq_is_wb 判定来区分 fill 流量和 writeback 流量。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复把之前被错误混在一起的两类 cache line 状态转换分离开来：一类是通过 fill 安装一条新行，另一类是因为写命中而把已有行标记为 dirty。如果这两种动作共用同一条通用 write-enable 路径，那么当 fill 与一个已存在且可能为脏的行发生碰撞时，就可能清除或保留错误的元数据、抑制本应存在的 writeback，或者把 tag 状态按普通命中的语义错误改写。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: fill 与命中写碰撞时的 cache line tag 和 dirty 状态更新
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个 fill 到达时，其 tag 已经匹配到一条驻留行，尤其是在该行为 dirty 或流水线中仍可能出现 redundant fill 的情况下。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 fill 安装和 write-hit 置脏重新合并到同一条控制路径，并让 redundant fill 继续走错误的 dirty 或 writeback 语义。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 合并 fill 和 write 的元数据更新路径
portability_notes: 可映射到任何维护 valid、dirty 和 tag 字段的 cache tag array 或 metadata RAM。
关键错误是把 fill 和写命中当成可互换的更新动作，尽管一个是在安装行，另一个只是把已有行置脏。
如果目标 DUT 可能观察到 redundant fill，注入后的故障也应在该场景下错误抑制或扭曲 writeback 决策。
concrete_injection_steps: 把独立的 fill 和 write 元数据控制重新合并成一条通用 write-enable 路径，让 tag 和 dirty 状态一起更新。
在 fill 时套用普通写命中的元数据规则，或在写命中时套用 fill 规则，而不是严格区分这两种状态转换。
当 fill 命中已有匹配行时，仅基于 tag match 去抑制 dirty 报告或 writeback，而不是依据完整的替换语义和行状态。
让 bank 侧的 writeback 请求逻辑继续依赖这些被混淆的元数据，使错误的 tag 和 dirty 语义向外部流量传播。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 负责 fill、write、invalidate 以及基于 dirty 的 writeback 的 tag access 与 tag store 控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 tag_store 中的 fill 与 write 行为拆开，让 fill 走显式 do_fill 路径，并在 bank 侧保持 fill 与 writeback 控制的分离，以修复与 redundant fill 相关的语义错误。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_tag_store 和 VX_tag_access 中，把 do_fill 与 do_write 合并回共享的 write_enable 风格路径，并在 VX_bank 中恢复更早版本里对 fill 与 writeback 的耦合控制。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 冗余或碰撞的 fill 可能错误清除或保留 dirty 状态、跳过本应发生的 writeback，或者错误改写 tag 元数据，最终导致修改过的数据丢失或 cache line 状态错误。
evidence_for_injection: 提交在 VX_tag_store 中引入了显式 do_fill 和 do_write，说明旧的共享控制在某些情形下语义上是错误的。
提交信息明确指向 dirty block 上的 redundant-fill bug，而不仅仅是 critical-path 清理。
VX_bank.v 在同一个补丁里区分了 fill request 与 writeback，表明该元数据修复会影响外部可见的 cache 行为。
notes: 本条目应理解为 fill 与 write 的 tag-state 语义修复。
后续提交 ce95c40aee45e7bc61a76eada543ac24256f2c36 继续修复 redundant fill 的生成时机，但这并不否定本提交修复的元数据语义问题。
